name: Deck, Bag, or Pool Building
description: Players start with a small, identical set of cards/components. Throughout the game, they acquire new cards/components from a central supply and add them to their personal deck/pool, gradually making it more powerful or tailored to their strategy. Players typically draw from and shuffle their personal decks.

parameters.name: Starting Deck Size/Composition
parameters.description: The initial number and type of cards players begin with.

parameters.name: Market/Supply Availability
parameters.description: How new cards are made available (e.g., 'static market', 'rotating display').

parameters.name: Culling/Trashing Mechanism
parameters.description: Are players able to remove weaker cards from their deck?

examples_in_games.specific_implementation_notes: The pioneering game for this mechanic, focusing purely on deck-building.
Combines deck-building with a board for movement and dungeon delving.

notes_on_combination_modification: Can be combined with almost any other objective mechanic. Modifiable by types of cards available (attacks, defense, currency, victory points) or how cards are acquired/played.
